name: layers-edit-qwen-image-edit-2511
title: Layers: edit one layer with Qwen Image Edit 2511
description: Places one transparent layer on mid grey, edits it with Qwen Image Edit 2511 and puts its alpha back. Your words reach the prompt at node 13. The draft run samples 4 steps with the Lightning LoRA, and the final run samples 40 steps with the base weights.
